summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a 6-K attaching an October 26, 2026 news release disclosing a leadership transition: President/CEO and director Sandeep Singh stepped down effective October 31, 2026, with Chairman Mark E. Smith named Interim CEO and CFO Michael Psihogios adding the President title effective November 1, 2026, while the Board launches a search for a permanent CEO. No price, stake, or premium terms apply. Smith and Psihogios will advance the Casino copper-gold project through YESAB Panel Review, with engineering optimization continuing and over C$120.6 million cash and investments as of September 30, 2026. Watch governance continuity and search timing for execution risk on permitting milestones.
